"""高考原声精读：原文译注检查→原音→共用分屏与排版→逐屏核查→4K→原音/画面独立核查。""" import argparse import hashlib import importlib.util import json import math import os from pathlib import Path import runpy import subprocess import sys import tempfile from 数据 import C, ROOT, HERE, LEAD, TAIL, FPS, dump, prepare, sha from 项目 import engine def call(argv): subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], check=True) def workflow_script(path, args): previous = sys.argv sys.argv = [str(path), *args] try: runpy.run_path(str(path), run_name='__main__') finally: sys.argv = previous def fingerprint(m, p, tm): h = hashlib.sha256() files = [Path(__file__), HERE/'数据.py', HERE/'片头检查.py', HERE/'审校登记.py', HERE/'覆盖检查.py', Path(m.__file__), m.QA/'layoutcheck.py', m.QA/'zh_bind.py', m.QA/'分词补充.txt', ROOT/'专八/tools/字号.json', ROOT/'四级/tools/fonts/fonts.css', *m.look_files('6')] for f in files: h.update(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)).encode()); h.update(f.read_bytes()) h.update(json.dumps([p, tm, m.SPLIT.get(p['id'], {})], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode()) return h.hexdigest() def input_snapshot(m, p, tm): return {'passage': p, 'timings': tm, 'split': m.SPLIT.get(p['id'], {})} def hint(m, p): return m.page('
GAOKAO ENGLISH'+m.esc(p['paper'])+'
' '
原声提示

请听录音中的考试提示

' '随后继续逐句精读
') def closing(m, p): return m.page('
GAOKAO ENGLISH'+m.esc(p['paper'])+'
' '
本套精读结束

'+m.esc(p['paper_title'])+'

' '') def build_states(m, p, d, tm, labels): flat = [s for para in p['paras'] for s in para] states = [(0, 'screen001'), (round(LEAD*FPS), 'hint')] shot = 1 for k, s in enumerate(flat, 1): parts = m.split_parts(p['id'], k, s) it = tm['sentences'][k-1] for n, (lo, hi, zh, tag) in enumerate(parts): t = it['start'] if not n else m.switch_time(C/'audio'/tm['file'], it, s['en'], lo) assert it['start']-.02 <= t <= it['end']+.02, f'{k} 分屏换屏超出本句' states.append((round(t*FPS), f'screen{shot+1:03d}')) shot += 1 assert shot == len(labels), f'画面映射{shot}≠排版{len(labels)}' papers = json.loads((C.parent/'套.json').read_text()) blocks = json.loads((C.parent/'识别'/papers[p['id']]['识别']/'分块.json').read_text()) for a,b,lang,text in blocks: if lang != 'zh' or not any(w in text for w in ['听','题','节','秒','回答','阅读','分钟']): continue if b <= d['cut'] or a >= tm['window'][1]: continue # 只有与英文句子不重叠的中文说明才插提示屏，避免语言误判覆盖实际英文。 overlaps = any(max(a,s['start']) < min(b,s['end'])-.10 for s in d['sentences']) if not overlaps: states.append((round((max(a,d['cut'])-d['cut']+LEAD)*FPS), 'hint')) speech_end = min(tm['duration']-2.0, tm['sentences'][-1]['end']+.20) states.append((round(speech_end*FPS), 'end')) unique = {} for frame, key in sorted(states, key=lambda x:(x[0], x[1].startswith('screen'))): if 0 <= frame < round(tm['duration']*FPS): unique[frame] = key out = [] for f,k in sorted(unique.items()): if not out or out[-1][1] != k: out.append([f,k]) required={f'screen{i+1:03d}' for i in range(len(labels))} assert required<={k for _,k in out},f'换屏量化吞掉正文画面：{required-{k for _,k in out}}' assert out[0] == [0, 'screen001'] and all(a[0]= 2 return out def stills(m, p, d, tm, out): from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright frozen=fingerprint(m,p,tm) shots = out/'shots'; shots.mkdir(exist_ok=True) labels = m.screens(p) f = out/'page.html' rows = [] with sync_playwright() as pw: br = pw.chromium.launch(executable_path=os.environ.get('GK_BROWSER','/opt/pw-browsers/chromium')) pg = br.new_page(viewport={'width':1920,'height':1080}, device_scale_factor=2) m.P_CUR = p for i, label, fit, r in m.layout(pg,p,f): if not fit: pg.evaluate(m.GK_COVER_FIT) if label=='片头': from 片头检查 import problems as cover_problems problems = cover_problems(pg,m,p['paper_title']) else: problems = m.screen_checks(pg,label,fit,r) if problems: pg.screenshot(path=str(shots/f'screen{i+1:03d}.bad.png')) raise ValueError('\n'.join(problems)) target=shots/f'screen{i+1:03d}.png'; pg.screenshot(path=str(target)) rows.append({'index':i,'label':label,'file':target.name,'sha256':sha(target),'sizes':r}) for key, body in [('hint',hint(m,p)),('end',closing(m,p))]: f.write_text(body,'utf-8');pg.goto(f.as_uri());pg.evaluate('document.fonts.ready') bad = pg.evaluate(m.TH.GLYPH) if bad: raise ValueError(f'{key} 缺字：{bad}') target=shots/(key+'.png');pg.screenshot(path=str(target)) rows.append({'label':key,'file':target.name,'sha256':sha(target)}) br.close() states=build_states(m,p,d,tm,labels) assert frozen==fingerprint(m,p,tm),'截图期间程序或输入改变，需按固定版本重跑' dump(out/'states.json',states) dump(out/'screens-input.json',input_snapshot(m,p,tm)) dump(out/'screens.json',{'id':p['id'],'fingerprint':fingerprint(m,p,tm),'problems':[], 'frames':round(tm['duration']*FPS),'shots':rows}) print(f'{p["id"]}：{len(rows)}张4K截图，{len(states)}个画面状态，全部排版检查0处',flush=True) return states def base_engine(): spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gk_audio_check',ROOT/'专八/听力/tools/听力视频.py') m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m) return m def audio_check(tm, out): """编码前用相同AAC参数完整往返，先拦截原音变速、音量或声道改变。""" import numpy as np import soundfile as sf encoded, decoded = out/'audio-precheck.m4a', out/'audio-precheck.wav' call(['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-i',C/'audio'/tm['file'], '-c:a','aac','-b:a','192k',encoded]) call(['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-i',encoded,'-c:a','pcm_f32le',decoded]) y,sr=sf.read(decoded,dtype='float32',always_2d=True) ref,sr2=sf.read(out/'source.wav',dtype='float32',always_2d=True) lo,hi=(round(t*sr2) for t in tm['window']);ref=ref[lo:hi] offset=round(LEAD*sr) bad=[] if sr!=tm['sample_rate'] or y.shape[1]!=tm['channels']: bad.append('AAC改变原采样率/声道') bad+=base_engine().orig_match(ref,y[offset:offset+len(ref)],sr) if abs(len(y)/sr-tm['duration'])>.05:bad.append('AAC时长偏差超过50毫秒') if np.abs(y[:offset-480]).max()>=.001:bad.append('片头静音不符') if len(y)-offset-len(ref)<2*sr or np.abs(y[offset+len(ref)+round(.05*sr):]).max()>=.001: bad.append('片尾静音不符') dump(out/'audio-precheck.json',{'ok':not bad,'problems':bad, 'source_sha256':tm['source_sha256'],'audio_sha256':tm['audio_sha256']}) encoded.unlink(missing_ok=True);decoded.unlink(missing_ok=True) assert not bad, f'音频预检失败：{bad}' print('原声AAC完整往返预检通过',flush=True) def verify(m, original, p, tm, out, mp4, states, fast=False): import numpy as np import soundfile as sf from fractions import Fraction info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_streams','-of','json',str(mp4)])) v=next(s for s in info['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='video') a=next(s for s in info['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='audio') frames=round(tm['duration']*FPS) checks=[] def check(name,ok,detail): checks.append({'name':name,'ok':bool(ok),'detail':detail}) expected=(480,270) if fast else (3840,2160) check('预演分辨率' if fast else '4K分辨率', (v['width'],v['height'])==expected,f'{v["width"]}×{v["height"]}') check('恒定30帧与完整帧数',Fraction(v['r_frame_rate'])==FPS and Fraction(v['avg_frame_rate'])==FPS and int(v['nb_read_frames'])==frames,str(v['nb_read_frames'])) check('声画时长',abs(float(a['duration'])-frames/FPS)<=.05,f'{a["duration"]}/{frames/FPS}') check('原采样率与声道',int(a['sample_rate'])==tm['sample_rate'] and int(a['channels'])==tm['channels'],f'{a["sample_rate"]}Hz {a["channels"]}声道') decoded=out/'verify.wav' call(['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-i',mp4,'-map','0:a:0','-c:a','pcm_f32le',decoded]) y,sr=sf.read(decoded,dtype='float32',always_2d=True) ref,sr2=sf.read(out/'source.wav',dtype='float32',always_2d=True) lo,hi=(round(t*sr2) for t in tm['window']);ref=ref[lo:hi] base=base_engine();offset=round(LEAD*sr) probs=base.orig_match(ref,y[offset:offset+len(ref)],sr) check('原声逐样本核对',not probs,probs or '音量差≤0.05dB、SNR≥30dB、逐秒差≤1dB') check('片头1.5秒静音',np.abs(y[:offset-480]).max()<.001,'1.5秒') check('片尾至少2秒静音',np.abs(y[offset+len(ref)+round(.05*sr):]).max()<.001 and len(y)-offset-len(ref)>=2*sr,'至少2秒') boundaries=[s[0] for s in states]+[frames] shotpaths=[out/'shots'/(s[1]+'.png') for s in states] if fast: from PIL import Image tiny=out/'fast-shots';tiny.mkdir(exist_ok=True) for path in set(shotpaths): # 使用与ffmpeg预演相同的scale滤镜，仅用于试跑画面核查。 call(['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-i',path,'-vf','scale=480:270',tiny/path.name]) shotpaths=[tiny/path.name for path in shotpaths] name,ok,detail=m.frame_check(mp4,boundaries,shotpaths) check(name,ok,detail) check('成品体积',0a rows.append(f"file '{out/'shots'/(key+'.png')}'\nduration {(b-a)/FPS:.9f}") rows.extend([f"file '{out/'shots'/(states[-1][1]+'.png')}'\nduration 1",f"file '{out/'shots'/(states[-1][1]+'.png')}'"]) listing=out/'concat.txt';listing.write_text('\n'.join(rows)+'\n') mp4=out/(p['paper_title']+' 高考英语真题 原文精读.mp4') cmd=['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-f','concat','-safe','0','-i',listing,'-i',C/'audio'/tm['file'], '-fps_mode','cfr','-r',FPS,'-frames:v',frames,'-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-tune','stillimage', '-crf','18','-threads',os.environ.get('GK_THREADS','2'),'-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-g','300', '-c:a','aac','-b:a','192k','-movflags','+faststart',mp4] if fast: i=cmd.index('-c:v');cmd[i:i]=['-vf','scale=480:270'];cmd[cmd.index('-preset')+1]='ultrafast';cmd[-1]=out/'预演.mp4' call(cmd) rep=verify(m,original,p,tm,out,Path(cmd[-1]),states,fast) if not fast: dump(out/'meta.json',{'id':p['id'],'套':p['id'],'kind':'text','mp4':mp4.name,'label':mp4.name, 'mp4_sha256':rep['sha256'],'mp4_bytes':rep['bytes'],'原音_sha256':tm['source_sha256'], '定稿_sha256':sha(C/'定稿'/f'{p["id"]}.json'), '译注_sha256':sha(C/'ann'/f'{p["id"]}.txt'), 'fingerprint':rep['fingerprint'],'成品核查':'全部通过'}) def main(): ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) ap.add_argument('sid');ap.add_argument('action',choices=['prepare','audio','precheck','stills','video','fast','all']) ap.add_argument('--original',type=Path,required=True);ap.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True) ap.add_argument('--draft',action='store_true',help='只用于未审预览，不准发布') args=ap.parse_args();out=args.out.resolve();out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) if os.environ.get('GK_HTTP'): from 本机预览 import enable enable([ROOT,out,Path(tempfile.gettempdir())],os.environ.get('GK_BROWSER','/usr/bin/chromium')) d,p,tm=prepare(args.sid,args.original,out,args.draft) if args.action=='prepare':return if args.action in ('audio','precheck','all'): audio_check(tm,out) if args.action=='audio':return m=engine();m.NAMES=d.get('names',[]) m.check_names(p) os.environ['DZB_PROJECT']='高考原文精读' suggestion=out/'split-suggestions.json' if args.action in ('precheck','all'): workflow_script(ROOT/'专八/tools/分屏建议.py',[args.sid,'--styles','6','--out',str(suggestion)]) workflow_script(ROOT/'专八/tools/分屏定稿.py',[str(suggestion),args.sid]) m.set_project('高考原文精读');m.NAMES=d.get('names',[]) if args.action in ('precheck','stills','all'): stills(m,p,d,tm,out) if args.action in ('video','fast','all'): encode(m,args.original,p,tm,out,args.action=='fast') if __name__=='__main__': main()
